results.question: Who are our best customers?
results.agentSql:
SELECT 
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    c.region,
    c.segment,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email, c.region, c.segment
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

results.question: Which products perform best?
results.agentSql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(CAST(oi.quantity AS REAL) * p.unit_price) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
